name: Anthropic Mom shirt lockups (angel-Clawd v4d/v4e/v4j + deterministic typesetting)
note: Print-ready T-shirt lockups: the BLESSED angel-Clawd mascots (v4d happy-eyes — Gary, 2026-08-08: 'cool do the shirt lockups thanks'; v4e blush and v4j chibi blessed mid-run via coordinator direction update) composited above deterministically TYPESET text. The mascot is the imported keyed PNG in inputs/ (derived recipe beside it) and is NEVER re-generated here; the text is NEVER produced by an image model (image models garble letterforms; deterministic graphics render in code, SPEC 4.11). Canvas is 4500x5400 px = 15x18 in at 300 DPI, the standard print-on-demand front-print area, transparent ground. Two type personalities: 'serif' = Charter Black/Bold (warm bookish Matthew Carter serif, the Anthropic-adjacent voice; Georgia/New York were the runners-up) and 'display' = Anton (heavy condensed geometric display sans). Anton is a DECLARED SUBSTITUTE: no pixel font (Press Start 2P / VT323 / Silkscreen) is installed on this machine or in any repo, and fonts are not downloaded without flagging. Text is rasterized by freetype from vector outlines AT final size (no upscaled raster); the mascot raster is upscaled LANCZOS from 1020px, which is soft-acceptable for sticker-style art but is the known quality ceiling. Every knob lives in params; generate.py reads THIS file and retypes nothing. TEXT REVISION mid-run (Gary): treatment B reads as one sentence, 'PROUD MOM' / 'OF AN ANTHROPIC APPLIED AI EVANGELIST'; the longer subline sets EITHER as one letterspaced line (treatment proud-mom) or two stacked letterspaced lines (treatment proud-mom-2line); both settings ship on v4d comparator variants so the proof sheet decides. Font picks for the new mascots (judged from the v4d matrix set in both faces): Charter serif for v4e-blush (warm bookish suits the soft blush), Anton for v4j-chibi (chunky display matches the chibi mass).

assertions: every tile is at shirt-print proportion: the lockup sits at print width on a garment-colored ground, top-chest placement, so Gary judges it as a shirt rather than as a poster

each lockup is proofed on ALL THREE grounds (white, burnt-orange tee, charcoal tee) including the ones where its text color deliberately vanishes, so colorway-to-garment pairing is chosen by eye, not asserted
the mascot reads identically in every lockup (it is one input PNG composited, never re-generated) and its natural colors read on both light and dark grounds
letterforms are crisp at print scale: typeset by freetype at final size, zero image-model text, zero upscaled text raster
the subline's letterspaced caps read as a quiet second voice under PROUD MOM, not as a second headline
everything sits comfortably inside the 15x18in print area with generous margins; nothing touches an edge
the one-line vs two-line subline settings sit side by side on v4d so the close call is decided by eye on garment grounds, not asserted
